scripts.lint: (if [ -n "${CARGO_FMT:-}" ]; then "$CARGO_FMT" --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --check; else cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --check; fi) && (if [ -n "${CARGO_CLIPPY:-}" ]; then "$CARGO_CLIPPY" clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings; else cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings; fi)
scripts.test: bun run build:native && node tools/run-test-profile.mjs source
scripts.test:portable: bun run build:native && node tools/run-test-profile.mjs portable-linux
scripts.test:owned-web-qualification: "${CARGO:-cargo}" build --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features && CURIOSITY_OWNED_WEB_QUALIFICATION=1 sandbox-exec -p '(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)' bun test tests/owned-web-qualification.test.ts
scripts.verify:legacy-memory-parity: node ../plugin/opencode2/tools/verify-legacy-memory-native-parity.mjs --verify-dependency-receipt && bun run --cwd ../plugin/opencode2 build && node ../plugin/opencode2/tools/verify-legacy-memory-native-parity.mjs --verify-baseline-blobs && node ../plugin/opencode2/tools/verify-legacy-memory-native-parity.mjs
